questions.question: Name four kinds of written sources.
questions.expected_answer: Letters, diaries, newspapers, records such as registers, logbooks and certificates, books, signs, plaques and street names.

questions.question: What three questions should you ask about a written source, and why?
questions.expected_answer: Who wrote it, when was it written, and why was it written? Because a writer can only write what they know, may make mistakes, and may tell only one side.

questions.question: How can the names of places give us information about the past? Use an example.
questions.expected_answer: Places are often named after people or events. Makhanda was named Grahamstown after the army officer John Graham, and in 2018 it was renamed Makhanda to honour the Xhosa prophet and warrior Makhanda, so the names tell us about different groups and their history.
